visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man in a grey beanie and black jacket stands in an outdoor park area with blooming cherry blossom trees. He smiles warmly at the camera with squinted eyes, holding a microphone just off-screen. (2) The scene cuts to an indoor exhibition hall with bright studio lighting. The man points towards a red-boxed Nintendo Switch 2 console displayed on a shelf. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the console box and the handheld device, which features vibrant blue and red Joy-Con controllers. (4) The man is seen playing a game featuring Donkey Kong on a large wall-mounted TV. He gestures excitedly towards the screen, showing high engagement through wide facial expressions and rapid hand movements. (5) Fast cuts show gameplay of Mario Kart on the large screen, followed by the man interacting with a small mouse-like controller on a white table. (6) The man stands before a red background featuring a large Nintendo Switch 2 logo, speaking directly to the camera while using expansive hand gestures to emphasize the hardware's features. (7) Final shots show the man demonstrating motion controls by punching the air and moving his body in sync with a party game on the TV screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male narrator speaking in Mandarin. His voice has a bright, enthusiastic tone with a clear, professional broadcast-quality articulation. Background music is a high-tempo electronic pop track with a strong synth bassline and crisp percussive beats at approximately 128 BPM. (2) A distinct digital 'pop' sound effect signals a transition. The narrator continues with high-arousal delivery, expressing excitement about the hardware. The acoustic environment shifts to a more resonant indoor hall with slight room reverberation. The electronic BGM remains constant in the background mix. (3) A series of 'ding' sound effects and high-pitched UI chimes accompany the close-up visuals of the console. The speaker's voice rises in pitch and intensity when describing the size of the box, punctuating the music's rhythm. (4) The audio layer incorporates gameplay sounds from Donkey Kong, featuring punchy percussive hits and synthesized jungle-themed music. The narrator's speech density increases, maintaining a fast-paced conversational flow over the steady electronic beat of the primary BGM. (5) A sharp mechanical sliding sound effect is introduced as the host demonstrates the peripheral. He emits a high-arousal 'Eh!' vocalization followed by laughter, indicating surprise. The Signal-to-Noise Ratio remains high, with the voice dominating the mix comfortably above the ambient chatter. (6) The video concludes with a summarizing narration delivered with authoritative but friendly energy. The background music swells in volume for the final five seconds, ending on a resolved major chord followed by a clean hard cut to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an enthusiastic hands-on preview and editorial review of the Nintendo Switch 2 console at an event in Japan. It aims to showcase hardware improvements, gameplay smoothness, and new peripherals to build excitement and inform the gaming community about upcoming technology.
